# Kemuri

> Kemuri is a single-node network latency monitor for Linux. It runs ICMP, HTTP, TCP, TLS, and DNS checks, stores results in SQLite, and displays smoke-style graphs.

Use this index to find the raw Markdown documentation published with the Kemuri website.

## Start here

- [Introduction](index.md): Learn what Kemuri does and where it fits.
- [Installation](guide/installation.md): Install Kemuri from a release, package, or container.
- [Quick start](guide/quick-start.md): Configure and start your first checks.
- [Configuration](reference/configuration.md): Read the full configuration reference.

## Guides

- [Web UI](guide/web-ui.md): Use the overview and check detail pages.
